_note: The village loudspeaker. files are relative to assets/ and baked by scripts/make_rozhlas.py (song, muffled announcement, clear OPAKUJEM, announcement again); the game stays silent until they exist. One broadcast every period_s seconds at a moment derived from the slot number; the SERVER decides when (its own clock) and tells the clients. lengths_s (one per file, written by scripts/make_rozhlas.py) lets the headless server know how long each lasts; default_length_s is used when one is missing. It is one shared recording, not one per speaker: the level depends only on the distance to the nearest speaker (full level within reference_distance, rolloff_db quieter per doubling beyond it, silent past max_distance) and its low-pass falls from near_cutoff_hz to far_cutoff_hz over the same range (duller with distance).
